title: SDV Linux PathFixer
summary: An offline pre-processing pipeline that sanitises Stardew Valley mods built on Windows so they run on Linux ARM64 handhelds like the Trimui Smart Pro. This repository's 'SDV' refers to Stardew Valley and has no connection to the Synthetic Data Vault library.
evidence: requirements.txt: '# SDV Linux PathFixer — 僅使用 Python 標準函式庫，無需安裝第三方套件'; README describes Stardew Valley mod tooling only
